msContents.summary: Private records relating to the correspondence, travels, business affairs, etc. of for the years 1860, 1864, 1866, 1871, 1872, 1873 and 1874. The diaries from the years of his first two African expeditions (1840–1843 and 1861–1862) are not included in this collection.

msContents.summary: The diary for 1866 is of particular historical interest, as it contains entries covering almost the entire duration of Beke’s final expedition to Abyssinia (1865–1866), which took place against the backdrop of the detention of British nationals by . Beke returned to Europe in May 1866.
